# Module `lune_ui_core::widgets::page`

[API reference](../../INDEX.md) / parent [`lune_ui_core::widgets`](../widgets.md)

The page card (`layout.page`, D148): header, a vertically scrolling body and an optional pinned
footer, with a keyed swap of the body.

[`Ui::page`](../ui.md#method.Ui.page) draws the card in the space it is given (margin 0 10 10 6 applied inside), then runs
one closure per slot, in tab order: the header actions, the body, the footer. Like the toolbar
it takes the glass layer from the caller and draws it whatever the window's state is (R13): the
widget names no preset.

The footer is fixed at [`FOOTER_H`](page.md#constant.FOOTER_H) (12 + a 32 px button row + 12) so the body's room is known
before the closure runs; its closure's return is ignored. A page is a container, so a disabled
page is `with_enabled(false)` around the call, as for any group.

The body is a [`scroll_area`](scroll_area.md) clipped to the card's rounded rect
([`Painter::push_clip_rounded`](../paint.md#method.Painter.push_clip_rounded)). Text cannot be cut
by a rounded clip (it takes the bounding rect), so the card keeps it out of the corners (D12):
its own title, subtitle and padded body are inset by 16, which is more than the radius of 8.

A change of [`PageOptions::swap_key`](page.md#structfield.PageOptions.swap_key) swaps the body: it fades in ([`SWAP_OPACITY`](page.md#constant.SWAP_OPACITY)) while it
slides up [`SWAP_DY`](page.md#constant.SWAP_DY) px ([`SWAP_SLIDE`](page.md#constant.SWAP_SLIDE), dropped under Reduced). The card, the header and the
footer stay put. The first frame of a page does not animate; a swap in flight restarts from
the look it has. A new key also puts the body back at the top.

**Fields**

- <a id="structfield.PageOptions.title"></a>`pub title: &'a str`

  The title (18 on a 24 px line, `fg_bright`, medium), elided to the room left of the actions.

- <a id="structfield.PageOptions.subtitle"></a>`pub subtitle: Option<&'a str>`

  The line under the title (13 on 20, `fg_tertiary`); it is also the group's description.

- <a id="structfield.PageOptions.glass"></a>`pub glass: GlassLayer`

  The glass layer the card draws.

- <a id="structfield.PageOptions.under"></a>`pub under: [f32; 4]`

  What the card is composed over (premultiplied); see [`ToolbarOptions::under`](toolbar.md#structfield.ToolbarOptions.under).

- <a id="structfield.PageOptions.actions_w"></a>`pub actions_w: f32`

  The width of the header's actions, at the right edge. 0 draws and calls none.

- <a id="structfield.PageOptions.footer"></a>`pub footer: bool`

  A pinned footer of [`FOOTER_H`](page.md#constant.FOOTER_H).

- <a id="structfield.PageOptions.swap_key"></a>`pub swap_key: u64`

  Which page the body holds: a change swaps it and scrolls to the top.

- <a id="structfield.PageOptions.name"></a>`pub name: &'a str`

  The group's accessible name; empty falls back to the title.

## Enums

<a id="enum.PageSlot"></a>
### Enum `PageSlot`

```rust
pub enum PageSlot {
    Actions(Rect),
    Body(ScrollView, Rect),
    Footer(Rect),
}
```

The slot a [`Ui::page`](../ui.md#method.Ui.page) closure is called for.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/widgets/page.rs:87`

**Variants**

- <a id="variant.PageSlot.Actions"></a>`Actions(Rect)`

  The header's actions: the right-aligned box, as wide as `actions_w` and as tall as the
  heading. Called only when `actions_w` is above 0. The header aligns its actions to the top,
  so the app puts them at the slot's top, not its middle.

- <a id="variant.PageSlot.Body"></a>`Body(ScrollView, Rect)`

  The body: the scroll view and the padded box content is drawn in (0 16 16, so the box is
  the viewport less 16 each side and 16 below). The closure returns the content's height.

- <a id="variant.PageSlot.Footer"></a>`Footer(Rect)`

  The footer's content row. Called only with `footer`.
